data.name: Codex-Named Unit (ability_inner_sea_gods_isg_abilities_faith_lst_418)
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you are granted insight into the finest techniques for crafting magic items, glimpsing secrets of forgotten master smiths and glimpsing the revelations of ancient dwarven masters. When calculating the base cost for creating an item, perform all the calculations and then reduce the base cost by 10%%. This discount affects the crafting time as well as the final price of the item. In addition, you can use fabricate once per day as a spell-like ability. Though you can't create magic items with the fabricate spell, you may use it to create items that you later enhance magically.
